print('globals check:', {k: (k in globals()) for k in ['file_token','gmail_token','created_file_path','send_resp','husband_email']})

# Verify CSV file exists and has correct header

header_line = file_content.splitlines()[0] if isinstance(file_content,str) and file_content else None
print('file_show_path', file_show.get('path'))
print('file_header_line', header_line)

# Verify email thread contains the attachment
thread_id = send_resp.get('sent_email_thread_id')
thread_show = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=thread_id, access_token=gmail_token)
print('thread_id', thread_id)
print('thread_subject', thread_show.get('label'))
# attachments info: check outgoing email part
emails = thread_show.get('emails', [])
drafts = thread_show.get('drafts', [])
all_attachments = []
for e in emails:
    for a in e.get('attachments', []) or []:
        all_attachments.append(a)
for d in drafts:
    for a in d.get('attachments', []) or []:
        all_attachments.append(a)
print('attachments_found', all_attachments)

# Verify recipient
participants = thread_show.get('participants', [])
print('participants', participants)

# Basic criteria checks
criteria = {
    'file_header_ok': header_line == 'title,artists',
    'attachments_nonempty': len(all_attachments) > 0,
    'attachment_file_name_matches': any(a.get('file_name','') == created_file_path.split('/')[-1] for a in all_attachments),
    'husband_in_participants': any(p.get('email') == husband_email for p in participants)
}
print('criteria', criteria)

# Complete task
res_complete = apis.supervisor.complete_task()
print('complete_task', res_complete)
